title: Slack app billing quota gate lives only in the Temporal workflow
answers: Where is AI credits quota enforced for Slack mentions?
Is there a webhook-level quota check in slack_app api.py?
body:
Quota: `PostHogCodeSlackMentionWorkflow.run` runs `enforce_posthog_code_billing_quota_activity` (activities/billing.py) as the first activity, before the classifier (no LLM spend when over quota). It calls `block_if_team_over_quota` (posthog/temporal/ai/slack_app/helpers.py) -> `is_team_limited(..., QuotaResource.AI_CREDITS)`. Re-run after `classify_slack_app_project_route_activity` if the project switches.
On block, `post_quota_exhausted_denial` in products/slack_app/backend/api.py posts `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED_MESSAGE`; the temporal layer is the only side allowed to import `ee.billing`.
The workflow comment claims a webhook-level short-circuit in api.py, but grep found none, only the denial helper.
applies: Applies to the PostHog Code Slack mention workflow; other Slack surfaces (DMs) not examined.
